nodes.label: Unit I: Intro to AI & Soft Computing (CO1)
nodes.phase: Unit I: AI & Soft Computing Foundations
nodes.description: AI perspectives, applications, present state of AI. Hard vs. Soft Computing: tolerance of imprecision, partial truth, neuro-computing characteristics, and learning/adaptation.
nodes.project: Compare a deterministic rule-based classifier (Hard) with a probabilistic/fuzzy classifier (Soft).
nodes.paper: Zadeh (1994) Fuzzy logic, neural networks, and soft computing

nodes.label: Unit II: Uninformed State-Space Search (CO2)
nodes.phase: Unit II: Problem Solving by Searching
nodes.description: Problem formulation as state space search, goal test, path cost. Breadth First Search (BFS) and Depth First Search (DFS) with time/space complexity.
key_topics: Problem formulation (S0, Actions, Transition, Goal, Cost)
nodes.project: Implement 8-puzzle state space solver using BFS and DFS with visited node tracking.
nodes.paper: Russell & Norvig (2020) AIMA Chapter 3: Solving Problems by Searching

nodes.label: Unit II: Informed Search & A* Algorithm (CO2)
nodes.phase: Unit II: Problem Solving by Searching
nodes.description: Heuristic evaluation functions. Greedy Best First Search (f(n)=h(n)) and A* Search (f(n)=g(n)+h(n)) with admissible and consistent heuristics.
nodes.project: Build an A* pathfinder with Manhattan and Euclidean distance heuristics comparing explored node counts.
nodes.paper: Hart, Nilsson & Raphael (1968) A Formal Basis for the Heuristic Determination of Minimum Cost Paths

nodes.label: Unit II: Local & Adversarial Search (CO2)
nodes.phase: Unit II: Problem Solving by Searching
nodes.description: Local search optimization: Hill Climbing (local maxima, ridges, plateaus), Simulated Annealing (Boltzmann probability). Adversarial Minimax and Alpha-Beta pruning.
nodes.project: Implement Tic-Tac-Toe / Connect-4 with Minimax algorithm and Alpha-Beta pruning.
nodes.paper: Kirkpatrick, Gelatt & Vecchi (1983) Optimization by Simulated Annealing

nodes.label: Unit III: Propositional & Predicate Logic (CO3)
nodes.description: Knowledge Representation Systems. Propositional Logic (syntax, semantics, truth tables, connectives). First-Order Predicate Logic (FOPL): predicates, universal and existential quantifiers.
key_topics: Formal Logic Connectives (and, or, not, implies, iff)
nodes.project: Implement a Propositional Logic truth table evaluator and validity verifier in Python.
nodes.paper: Russell & Norvig (2020) AIMA Chapter 7 & 8: Logical Agents & First-Order Logic

nodes.label: Unit III: Inference & Resolution in FOPL (CO3)
nodes.description: Inference rules in FOPL, Forward Chaining (data-driven), Backward Chaining (goal-directed), Unification, and Resolution refutation via Conjunctive Normal Form (CNF).
nodes.project: Build an automated First-Order Logic resolution refutation prover.
nodes.paper: Robinson (1965) A Machine-Oriented Logic Based on the Resolution Principle

nodes.label: Unit III: Uncertain Knowledge & Bayes Rule (CO3)
nodes.description: Handling uncertain knowledge. Random variables, Prior and Posterior Probability, Bayes' Rule, conditional independence, and probabilistic inference.
nodes.project: Build a Naive Bayes probabilistic diagnostic classifier with prior/posterior step visualization.
nodes.paper: Pearl (1988) Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems

nodes.label: Unit IV: Fuzzy Sets & Membership Functions (CO4)
nodes.phase: Unit IV: Fuzzy Set Theory & Inference
nodes.description: Crisp Sets vs Fuzzy Sets. Membership functions mu(x) in [0, 1]. Features of membership functions (core, support, boundary). Triangular (trimf), Trapezoidal (trapmf), Gaussian.
nodes.project: Code a pure Python fuzzy set library implementing trimf, trapmf, and fuzzy operations.
nodes.paper: Zadeh (1965) Fuzzy Sets (Information and Control)

nodes.label: Unit IV: Mamdani & Sugeno FIS (CO4)
nodes.phase: Unit IV: Fuzzy Set Theory & Inference
nodes.description: Fuzzy If-Then rules, fuzzy reasoning. Fuzzy Inference Systems (FIS): Mamdani FIS (Max-Min composition, Centroid defuzzification) vs Sugeno FIS (polynomial consequent, weighted average).
nodes.project: Implement Mamdani and Sugeno FIS engines with Centroid and Weighted Average defuzzification.
nodes.paper: Mamdani & Assilian (1975) An experiment in linguistic synthesis with a fuzzy logic controller; Takagi & Sugeno (1985)

nodes.label: Unit V: McCulloch-Pitts & Biological Neurons (CO5)
nodes.description: Biological neuron anatomy (soma, dendrites, axon, synapses). McCulloch-Pitts neuron model: excitatory and inhibitory inputs, binary threshold activation function.
key_topics: Realization of Logic Gates (AND, OR, NOT, NAND)
nodes.project: Implement logic gates (AND, OR, NOT, NOR) using McCulloch-Pitts neurons with analytical thresholds.
nodes.paper: McCulloch & Pitts (1943) A logical calculus of the ideas immanent in nervous activity

nodes.label: Unit V: Perceptrons & Backpropagation (CO5)
nodes.description: Single-layer Perceptron, Linear separability and the XOR problem. Delta learning rule (Widrow-Hoff LMS). Multi-layer Perceptron (MLP) and Backpropagation error gradient derivation.
nodes.project: Implement Perceptron learning showing failure on XOR, followed by a 2-layer MLP solving XOR.
nodes.paper: Rosenblatt (1958) The Perceptron; Rumelhart, Hinton & Williams (1986)

nodes.label: Unit V: Hebbian Learning & Kohonen SOM (CO5)
nodes.description: Unsupervised neural learning: Hebbian Learning rule ('neurons that fire together wire together'), Winner-Take-All competition, Kohonen Self-Organizing Maps (SOM), and LVQ.
nodes.project: Implement a 2D Kohonen Self-Organizing Map clustering RGB color vectors.
nodes.paper: Kohonen (1982) Self-organized formation of topologically correct feature maps

nodes.label: Unit VI: Hybrid Systems & ANFIS (CO6)
nodes.description: Introduction to Hybrid Systems (industrial control, robotics). Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS): 5-layer architecture, hybrid learning (gradient descent + least squares).
key_topics: Comparative Evaluation: Fuzzy vs Neural vs Neuro-Fuzzy
nodes.project: Implement a toy 5-layer ANFIS model approximating nonlinear functions with hybrid learning.
nodes.paper: Jang (1993) ANFIS: Adaptive-Network-Based Fuzzy Inference System

nodes.label: Python & Scientific Computing Stack
nodes.description: Python vectorized arrays with NumPy, Pandas dataframes, and Matplotlib data visualizers.
nodes.project: Build an exploratory data analysis pipeline.
nodes.paper: Harris et al. (2020) Array programming with NumPy

nodes.label: Linear Algebra for AI/ML
nodes.description: Vectors, matrices, dot products, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and singular value decomposition.
nodes.project: Implement image compression using SVD.
nodes.paper: Strang (2016) Introduction to Linear Algebra

nodes.label: Optimization Algorithms (SGD, Momentum, AdamW)
nodes.description: Gradient descent, momentum, RMSprop, Adam, and AdamW weight decay decoupling.
nodes.project: Optimizer trajectory visualization on loss surfaces.
nodes.paper: Loshchilov & Hutter (2019) AdamW

nodes.label: Attention Mechanisms & Transformers
nodes.description: Scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, and transformer self-attention blocks.
nodes.project: Implement scaled dot-product attention in PyTorch.
nodes.paper: Vaswani et al. (2017) Attention Is All You Need

nodes.label: Autoregressive LLMs & Generative AI
nodes.description: Causal generation, KV cache, nucleus sampling, temperature, and open-source models (Gemma).
nodes.project: Build an efficient autoregressive generator with KV caching.
nodes.paper: Radford et al. (2019) GPT-2

nodes.label: Multivariable Calculus & Gradients
nodes.description: Partial derivatives, Jacobian matrices, Hessians, and gradient vector fields for optimization.
nodes.project: Implement automatic numerical gradient checker in Python.
nodes.paper: Spivak (2006) Calculus

nodes.label: Probability & Statistical Foundations
nodes.description: Random variables, joint distributions, conditional probability, expectation, and Bayes theorem.
nodes.project: Build a Naive Bayes classifier from scratch using NumPy.
nodes.paper: Wasserman (2004) All of Statistics
